response.original_title: ✦〖AIDA#Complaint-Resolution〗✦ How Do I Submit a Formal Booking Dispute to AIDA Cruises?
response.overview: To raise a dispute or escalate a billing/service issue with AIDA Cruises[ +1-877-698-2211], follow these steps: To raise a dispute with AIDA Cruises[ +1-877-698-2211] you must follow a structured process starting with their customer relations team before escalating to official consumer protection bodies. You can request final statements through AIDA Post-Cruise Inquiries. Call customer support: Reach out by phone +1-877-698-2211 post-cruise to request a formal billing investigation. To dispute a AIDA Cruises charge, you should contact AIDA’s Post Cruise Assistance at +1-877-698-2211 or email AIDAguestrelations@rccl.com with your booking details and receipts. Provide exact dates, names, and charges, then request a reference number so you can track progress and repeat details less often later.
